title: Joseph J NDE 729
content:
From: Joseph (Original Message) Sent: 06/06/2002 1:13 p.m. I got crushed to death! I was unloading coils of steel off a semi-truck. The load was short blocked, so I cut the steel banding. Then the coil rolled forward, bounced and rolled back pushing me onto the forks of the forklift. The next thing I saw was me, doing the post-mortem kick. Then the angel holding my hand told me, 'You're not done here!' He took me to a place that I can only describe as a Light and Sound, and the feeling of Love like in my mother's arms. Knowing that I was safe, I wanted to stay there! The angel told me, 'You're not done here, you have to go back!' The next thing that I saw was the paramedics putting the pads to me. Pain, fear, I can't breathe, went into shock. After eight hours of the doctors trying save my life, I was moved to the intensive care unit. When I woke up my mother was holding my hand - I passed out! Sometime later - about eighteen hours - I woke-up again in pain. My mom was still holding my hand. I started to cry! More later. Light and Love to All! Joseph

From: Joseph (Original Message) Sent: 06/06/2002 1:13 p.m.

I got crushed to death!

I was unloading coils of steel off a semi-truck. The load was short blocked, so I cut the steel banding. Then the coil rolled forward, bounced and rolled back pushing me onto the forks of the forklift.

The next thing I saw was me, doing the post-mortem kick. Then the angel holding my hand told me, 'You're not done here!' He took me to a place that I can only describe as a Light and Sound, and the feeling of Love like in my mother's arms. Knowing that I was safe, I wanted to stay there!

The angel told me, 'You're not done here, you have to go back!' The next thing that I saw was the paramedics putting the pads to me. Pain, fear, I can't breathe, went into shock. After eight hours of the doctors trying save my life, I was moved to the intensive care unit. When I woke up my mother was holding my hand - I passed out! Sometime later - about eighteen hours - I woke-up again in pain. My mom was still holding my hand. I started to cry!

More later.

Light and Love to All!

Joseph

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death Crushed by an 8,642 pound coil of steel. Dead on arrival.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Like an astral body! Not like the other souls that were moving around me!
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It seemed I was gone days! Then I saw the paramedics put the pads to me!
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: The most wonderful music I'd ever heard!
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A friend that had died years before! In the lights and sound! Yes, Lee R.! He told me that it was good to see me!
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes One Very bright, and hundreds of thousands of smaller lights!
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Light and Sound!
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe A purpose, duty, and task! I still don't know what it is! Yet!!
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control The one holding my hand said, 'You are not finished here! You have to go back!'
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will 'You are not finished here! You have to go back!'
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I became a lord - 'Reverend of The Church of Light Works.'
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Yes, The Love, Light, Sound!
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I saw an angel stop traffic, and then a big truck (eighteen wheeler) drove right through the intersection!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes June of 1998 IANDS (International Association for Near-Death Studies) Seattle, Washington.
